newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Afghan Taleban rebels claim take key base.
newsitem.headline: Afghan Taleban rebels claim take key base.

text.p: Afghanistan's Taleban Islamic militia said on Wednesday it had captured the strategic government town of Sarobi, east of the capital Kabul.
Taleban sources, quoted by a Pakistan-based Afghan news service, said the militia took the town, 70 km (44 miles) from the capital, in overnight fighting.
No independent confirmation was immediately available.

Taleban sources said on Tuesday their forces had advanced towards Sarobi, which lies in Kabul province, on two fronts, from Hisarak district in the adjoining Nangarhar province to Jendalak mountain about 10 km (six miles) from the town, and along the main eastern Jalalabad-Kabul highway.
